people.name: Beth-Ashtoreth
people.line: Philistine city where Saul's armor was put in a temple.

people.name: Beth-shean
people.line: City in Manasseh, where Saul's body was displayed.

translations.web: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.
translations.bsb: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.
translations.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.
translations.asv: And they put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth; and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
